What We Do

Our Roofing and Guttering Services

From a few slipped tiles to a complete new roof, plus the flat roofs, chimneys and gutters around it.

Roof Repairs

Slipped and broken tiles, leaks and storm damage found and put right before the damage spreads.

Get a quote

New Roofs

Stripped back and rebuilt with new membrane, battens and tiles or slates, with advice on the right roof for the house.

Get a quote

Flat Roofing

Practical, low-maintenance flat roofs for extensions, garages, conversions and outbuildings.

Get a quote

Guttering, Fascias and Soffits

UPVC gutters, fascias and soffits that keep rainwater off the walls and need very little upkeep.

Get a quote

Chimney Repairs

Chimney stacks repaired and made watertight, with new lead flashing where the stack meets the roof.

Get a quote

Tiling and Slating

Breathable membrane and treated battens laid properly under new tiles or slates, roof windows included.

Get a quote
